sentences.text: Shri Ramanuj Choubey -Panel Lawyer for the respondent

no Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the evidence of the petitioner has been closed by court order dated 30.05.2023 and revision against the said order has also been dismissed by learned revisional court.

With reference to some document viz memorandum (Annexure A/5) prepared in Crime No. 332/2022 under section 294, 506, 420, 384 of IPC and under section 3(2)(va) of SC/ST Act and the order dated 01.12.2023 passed in the present case, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the cheque in question is not proved to be legally enforceable as the same was filled for the excess amount by the complainant as has been admitted in the aforesaid memorandum, which would be proved by the petitioner in his evidence, in case of opportunity to lead evidence is accorded to the petitioner.

Vide order dated 01.12.2023, the court has observed that the cheque issued by the bank in question could not be enforced as bank already stood merged with the Canara Bank w.e.f 01.04.2020 and thereafter the cheque in question could not have been issued by the accused/petitioner.
In fact only five opportunities were granted to the petitioner and findings to the contrary recorded in the impugned order are factually wrong.

Issue notice to the respondents on payment of process fee within seven working days by RAD mode,
returnable within four weeks.
Till the next date of hearing, the trial court shall not pronounce the final order.

(RAJ MOHAN SINGH) JUDGE tarun Hansmani Rohni vs Rajesh Singh Gahlot (Saini) on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154791924/
